mirage_ct_queue_a.title: Mirage CT A Default
mirage_ct_queue_a.description:
Purchase: 1 incendiary, 1 smoke, 2 flash
The role of an incendiary grenade: to stop early push from the pit
The role of the smoke grenade is to create a space for safe entry into the middle/control of the middle
The role of the first flash drive is to blind the players at an early time, who run to the middle at an early time.
The role of the second flash drive: behind the smoke, the flash drive also blinds, it is not visible, a kind of airbag

mirage_ct_queue_b.title: Mirage CT B Default
mirage_ct_queue_b.description:
Purchase: 1 incendiary, 1 smoke, 1 HE
The role of an incendiary grenade: to stop a possible push from the T side
The role of HE: if you have information about B apartments, you can throw it deeply (or assume their presence there)
 The role of smoke: if you see, that T side is extinguished your molly (B push), you MUST throw smoke out your legs and play for him (if they are will push into smoke, you will see them first -> advantage, in other way it gives you time to be alive, and open space)

mirage_t_queue_a.title: Mirage T A Default (support)
mirage_t_queue_a.description:
Purchase: 1 smoke, 1 incendiary, 2 flashes
 The role of smoke and incendiary is to zone stairs
Flashes are momental and non visible to CT
